<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="light"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>CARÉL — Dream · Bloom · Shine</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bodoni+Moda:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400;1,500&family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;500&family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--rq:#FBEDEC;--bp:#E5A9A9;--ch:#EDECDB;--iv:#FCFBF6;--rg:#D4A5A7;--dr:#E6748E;--mb:#9A4560;--mr:#493741;--bg:var(--iv);--ink:var(--mr);--card:#fff;--line:rgba(201,143,147,.5);--btn:#493741;--on:#FCFBF6;--gd:linear-gradient(120deg,#C98F93,#F3D2C4 45%,#D4A5A7 60%,#B97C86);--pearl:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 28%,#fff,#FBEDEC 62%,#F3E4F0);box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#2D1F2A;--ink:#FBEFF1;--card:#3B2837;--rq:#4A3245;--mb:#F4B6C6;--btn:#F3C9D1;--on:#2D1F2A;--mr:#F3C9D1;--line:rgba(243,201,209,.28)}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#2D1F2A;--ink:#FBEFF1;--card:#3B2837;--rq:#4A3245;--mb:#F4B6C6;--btn:#F3C9D1;--on:#2D1F2A;--mr:#F3C9D1;--line:rgba(243,201,209,.28)}
html{scroll-padding-top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 90px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:300 15px/1.75 Montserrat,system-ui,sans-serif}
h1,h2{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond','Bodoni Moda',serif;font-weight:500;font-style:italic;margin:0;letter-spacing:.01em}h3{margin:0;font-weight:400}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mb);outline-offset:3px}
.bar{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#F9DCDC,#EDECDB 50%,#EADCF3);color:#493741;text-align:center;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 12px;min-height:38px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.bar span{transition:opacity .5s}
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 88%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.hd{max-width:1280px;margin:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;padding:12px 28px}
.logo{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;line-height:1}
.logo b{font:500 34px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;letter-spacing:.34em;margin-right:-.34em;background:var(--gd);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.logo i{font:400 8.5px Montserrat;letter-spacing:.42em;margin:7px -.42em 0 0;color:var(--mb);font-style:normal}
nav{display:flex;gap:26px;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase}
nav a{padding:4px 0;background:var(--gd) bottom/0 1px no-repeat;transition:background-size .3s,color .3s}nav a:hover{background-size:100% 1px;color:var(--mb)}
.ic{display:flex;gap:4px;justify-content:flex-end}.ic button{background:none;border:0;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;position:relative;transition:.25s}
.ic button:hover{background:var(--rq);color:var(--mb)}.ic svg{width:19px;height:19px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.2}
.cnt{position:absolute;top:3px;right:1px;background:var(--dr);color:#493741;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:500;min-width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:8px;line-height:15px}
.menu{display:none}
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(55% 45% at 12% 8%,#EADCF3,transparent 70%),radial-gradient(50% 45% at 90% 15%,#F9DCDC,transparent 70%),radial-gradient(60% 40% at 50% 100%,#F3E4F0,transparent 70%),var(--iv)}
.hero-in{max-width:1280px;margin:auto;padding:56px 24px 56px;text-align:center;position:relative}
.crest{width:84px;height:84px;margin:0 auto 12px;display:block}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(44px,7.4vw,98px);line-height:.98;max-width:11em;margin:0 auto}
.hero p{font:italic 400 22px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;color:var(--mb);margin:20px 0 34px}
.btn{position:relative;display:inline-block;padding:15px 36px;background:var(--btn);color:var(--on);border:0;outline:1px solid var(--rg);outline-offset:4px;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:.3s;overflow:hidden}
.btn:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:-80%;width:50%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.45),transparent);transform:skewX(-20deg);transition:left .6s}
.btn:hover{background:#F0B3BF;color:#493741}.btn:hover:after{left:130%}
.btn.o{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rg)}.btn.o:hover{background:var(--rq)}
.hero .btns{display:flex;gap:26px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.frame{max-width:980px;margin:62px auto 0;padding:18px;border-radius:360px 360px 22px 22px;background:linear-gradient(#fff,#FDF1F0);box-shadow:0 40px 90px -40px rgba(154,69,96,.45);outline:1px solid var(--rg);outline-offset:9px}
.frame img{display:block;width:100%;border-radius:342px 342px 10px 10px;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.sp{position:absolute;color:var(--rg);animation:tw 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes tw{0%,100%{opacity:.2;transform:scale(.8)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.15)}}
section{max-width:1280px;margin:auto;padding:100px 28px}
.sh{text-align:center;margin-bottom:46px}.sh h2{font-size:clamp(36px,4.6vw,60px);line-height:1.05}
.sh p{max-width:34em;margin:14px auto 0;color:var(--mb)}
.orn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px;color:var(--dr)}.orn:before,.orn:after{content:"";height:1px;width:90px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--rg))}.orn:after{transform:scaleX(-1)}.orn svg{width:44px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.2}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:40px 28px}
.card{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.phw{position:relative;margin:10px 10px 0}
.ph{aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:999px 999px 12px 12px;background:var(--pearl);outline:1px solid var(--line);outline-offset:7px;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;transition:box-shadow .4s,transform .4s}
.card:hover .ph{box-shadow:0 26px 50px -26px rgba(154,69,96,.5);transform:translateY(-4px)}
.ph img{width:80%;height:72%;object-fit:contain;mix-blend-mode:multiply;margin-top:18%}
.tag{position:absolute;top:48%;left:-14px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#F6C4CD,#F0A3B4);color:#493741;font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 20px 5px 14px;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 9px) 50%,100% 100%,0 100%)}
.wl{position:absolute;bottom:12px;right:12px;background:var(--card);border:0;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;color:var(--mb);box-shadow:0 6px 16px -6px rgba(154,69,96,.5);transition:.25s}.wl:hover{transform:scale(1.1)}
.wl svg{width:18px;height:18px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.3}.wl.on svg{fill:var(--dr);stroke:var(--dr)}
.bd{padding:22px 6px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;flex:1;text-align:center}
.bd h3{font:500 19px 'Playfair Display',serif}.bd .k{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mb);letter-spacing:.06em}.bd .pr{font:400 16px 'Playfair Display',serif}
.sw{display:flex;gap:9px;justify-content:center;margin:6px 0 2px}.sw button{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;border:0;padding:0;position:relative;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(154,69,96,.25)}
.sw button:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 26%,rgba(255,255,255,.8),transparent 55%)}
.sw button.on{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg),0 0 0 3px var(--mb)}
.sn{font-size:11px;min-height:18px;letter-spacing:.08em;font-style:italic}
.add{margin:8px auto 0;min-width:170px;border:0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rg);background:none;padding:11px 22px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:.3s}
.add:hover{background:var(--btn);color:var(--on)}
.story{background:linear-gradient(#78364D,#572033);max-width:none;padding:0;border-block:1px solid var(--line)}.story>div{max-width:780px;margin:auto;padding:90px 24px;text-align:center}
.story h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.2vw,54px);line-height:1.12}.story .crest{width:64px;height:64px}
.bs .stars{color:var(--dr);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3em}
.chips{display:flex;gap:30px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:40px}.chips button{border:0;background:none;padding:6px 2px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.65;background:var(--gd) bottom/0 1px no-repeat;transition:.3s}.chips button.on,.chips button:hover{opacity:1;background-size:100% 1px;color:var(--mb)}
.nl{display:flex;gap:14px;max-width:520px;margin:auto}.nl input{flex:1;padding:13px 4px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rg);background:none;color:var(--ink);min-width:0;font-size:14px}.nl input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--mb)}
footer{background:#35131F;color:#E8CBAE;padding:70px 24px 50px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
footer b{display:block;font:500 40px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;letter-spacing:.34em;margin-bottom:8px;background:var(--gd);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(73,55,65,.45);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s;z-index:40}.ov.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.dr{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:min(420px,100%);background:var(--bg);z-index:50;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .4s;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.dr.on{transform:none}.dh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.dh h3{font:italic 500 28px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif}.dh button{background:none;border:0;font-size:26px}
.di{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:12px 24px}.li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1fr auto;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.li img{width:64px;height:64px;object-fit:contain;background:#FBEDEC;padding:4px;border-radius:32px 32px 6px 6px;mix-blend-mode:multiply}.li h4{margin:0;font:500 15px 'Playfair Display',serif}.li small{color:var(--mb)}
.q{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:4px}.q button{width:24px;height:24px;border:1px solid var(--rg);background:none;border-radius:50%;line-height:1}
.df{padding:20px 24px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.tot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:500 18px 'Playfair Display',serif;margin-bottom:6px}
.ship{font-size:12px;color:var(--mb);margin-bottom:14px}.pg{height:3px;background:var(--rq);margin:6px 0 14px}.pg i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--gd);transition:.3s}
.df .btn{width:100%;text-align:center}.empty{text-align:center;padding:60px 0;color:var(--mb)}
.sr{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;background:var(--bg);z-index:50;padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 28px) 24px 28px;transform:translateY(-100%);transition:.4s}
.sr.on{transform:none}.sr input{width:100%;max-width:700px;display:block;margin:auto;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rg);background:none;font:italic 500 32px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;color:var(--ink);padding:8px 0}
.sr input:focus{outline:none}.sr p{text-align:center;color:var(--mb);font-size:13px}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 24px);transform:translate(-50%,40px);background:var(--btn);color:var(--on);padding:13px 28px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;opacity:0;transition:.3s;z-index:60;outline:1px solid var(--rg);outline-offset:3px}
.toast.on{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.dr.pd{width:min(560px,100%)}.pdb{padding-top:18px}.pdb .pn{font:italic 500 38px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;margin:4px 0}.pdb .pr{font-size:20px}
.lk{background:none;border:0;padding:0;font:inherit;text-align:center}.pdq{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin:16px 0}.pdq .q{margin:0}.pdq .wl{position:static}
.sw.lg button{width:30px;height:30px}.pdb details{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 0}.pdb summary{cursor:pointer;font:500 11px Montserrat;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}
.pdb details p,.pdb details li{font-size:13.5px;margin:8px 0}.pdb ul{padding-left:18px;margin:6px 0}.note{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mb);margin-top:14px}
.mnav{display:none;flex-direction:column;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 24px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}.mnav.on{display:flex}.mnav a{padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
@media(max-width:980px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}nav{display:none}.menu{display:block}.hd{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto}.hd .logo{justify-self:center}.frame{border-radius:200px 200px 18px 18px}.frame img{border-radius:184px 184px 8px 8px}}
@media(max-width:700px){.grid[style]{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}}
@media(max-width:520px){.grid{gap:30px 12px}.bd h3{font-size:16px}.tag{left:-8px;font-size:8px;padding:4px 14px 4px 9px}section{padding:64px 16px}.hero-in{padding-inline:14px}.frame{padding:10px}}
@media(min-width:1101px){.mnav{display:none!important}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
.hero h1,.hero p,.hero .btns{animation:rise .9s both}.hero p{animation-delay:.15s}.hero .btns{animation-delay:.3s}@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}}
.mega{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(-6px);transition:.3s}.mega.on{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:none}
.mg{max-width:1000px;margin:auto;padding:30px 28px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:center}.mg h4{font:italic 500 26px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;margin:0 0 8px}.mg a{display:block;padding:5px 0;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}.mg a:hover{color:var(--mb)}
.mgp{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center}.mgp .arch{width:110px;aspect-ratio:4/5;margin:0}.mgp p{font:italic 500 20px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;margin:0}.mgp small{font:300 12px Montserrat}
.arch{aspect-ratio:4/5;width:100%;max-width:440px;border-radius:999px 999px 14px 14px;background:var(--pearl);outline:1px solid var(--line);outline-offset:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;margin:10px auto}.arch img{width:82%;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.1fr;gap:72px;align-items:center}.split h2{font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,68px);line-height:1.02}.split p{max-width:30em}.split.rev .arch{order:2}
.look{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:28px;text-align:center}.mini{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:999px 999px 10px 10px;background:var(--pearl);outline:1px solid var(--line);outline-offset:5px;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;margin:6px 6px 16px}.mini img{width:78%;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.lk4 h4{font:500 16px 'Playfair Display',serif;margin:0}.lk4 small{color:var(--mb);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.6}.lkb{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;margin-top:18px}.lkb .pr{font:400 20px 'Playfair Display',serif;margin-bottom:16px}

.pan{aspect-ratio:3/4;padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;border-radius:200px 200px 12px 12px;outline:1px solid var(--line);outline-offset:6px;color:#493741;text-align:center}.pan h3{font:italic 500 30px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;line-height:1.1}.pan small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px}.pan p{margin:6px 0 10px;font-size:13px}
.sq{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:14px;background:var(--pearl);display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden}.sq img{width:72%;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.ctl{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:-16px 0 40px}.ctl select{background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 16px;font:inherit;font-size:12px}
.qv{background:none;border:0;font-size:11px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;color:var(--mb);margin-top:2px}
.carw{position:relative}#g2{display:flex;gap:30px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding:8px 14px 26px;scrollbar-width:thin}#g2 .card{flex:0 0 min(270px,74vw);scroll-snap-align:start}
.car{position:absolute;top:34%;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--card);font-size:22px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px -8px rgba(154,69,96,.5);z-index:2}.car.l{left:-8px}.car.r{right:-8px}
.fc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:30px;max-width:900px;margin:40px auto 0;text-align:left;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:13px}.fc h4{font:500 11px Montserrat;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 10px}.fc a,.fc span{display:block;padding:3px 0}.fc a:hover{color:var(--mb)}
.load{position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--bg);z-index:100;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:opacity .7s}
.bn{display:none;position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:30;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 92%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:6px 8px calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 6px);justify-content:space-around}.bn button{background:none;border:0;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:8px 10px}
@media(max-width:700px){.bn{display:flex}body{padding-bottom:62px}.toast{bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 78px)}.split{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px}.split.rev .arch{order:0}.look{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.fc{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.mg{grid-template-columns:1fr}.mgp{display:none}.car{display:none}}

:root{--rq:#EBD3D8;--bp:#D6A3B0;--ch:#E8CBAE;--iv:#FBF7F4;--rg:#D6A3B0;--dr:#A85870;--mb:#78364D;--mr:#35131F;--bg:#FBF7F4;--ink:#24191D;--card:#fff;--line:rgba(120,54,77,.22);--btn:#572033;--on:#FBF7F4;--gd:linear-gradient(120deg,#C9A27F,#F3DDC4 45%,#E8CBAE 60%,#B98A66);--pearl:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 28%,#fff,#FBF3F1 62%,#EBD3D8)}
.dk{--bg:#572033;--ink:#F6E7E2;--mb:#E8CBAE;--card:#6B2A40;--line:rgba(232,203,174,.32);--btn:#E8CBAE;--on:#35131F;--rq:#78364D;--mr:#F6E7E2;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
.dkx{--bg:#35131F;--card:#4A1A2B}footer.dk{background:#35131F}.story.dk{background:linear-gradient(#78364D,#572033)}
.fb{max-width:none!important;padding-inline:max(28px,calc((100vw - 1224px)/2))}
.hero{background:radial-gradient(60% 55% at 50% 0%,#78364D,transparent 72%),radial-gradient(45% 45% at 92% 100%,#A85870,transparent 70%),linear-gradient(#572033,#35131F)}
.bar{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#78364D,#A85870 50%,#78364D);color:#FBF7F4;border-color:transparent}
.sp{color:#E8CBAE}.dk .orn{color:#E8CBAE}.dk .crest text{fill:#E8CBAE}.dk .crest circle{stroke:#E8CBAE}.dk .btn.o{color:var(--ink)}
.cnt{background:#E8CBAE;color:#35131F}.load{background:#35131F}.load .crest text{fill:#E8CBAE}.load .crest circle{stroke:#E8CBAE}
.btn:hover{background:#F3DDC4;color:#35131F}.dk .btn.o:hover{background:rgba(232,203,174,.14)}
.ing{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px}
.ic2{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:26px 16px;text-align:center;color:var(--ink);min-height:200px;transition:.3s}.ic2:hover,.ic2.on{border-color:#E8CBAE;background:rgba(232,203,174,.12);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.gem{width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 14px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%,#fff,#E8CBAE 38%,#A85870 100%);display:grid;place-items:center;font:italic 500 28px 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;color:#35131F}
.ic2 h4{font:500 16px 'Playfair Display',serif;margin:0 0 4px}.ic2 small{font-style:italic;color:var(--mb);font-size:12px}

<section id="house" class="dk fb"><div class="split"><div class="arch"><img data-pi="0" alt="Once Upon a Dream eyeshadow palette"></div><div><h2>More than beauty. A world of its own.</h2><p style="margin:18px 0">CARÉL began with a quiet idea: a beauty ritual can feel like opening a jewel box. Inspired by enchanted gardens, royal architecture and the small, brave pleasure of choosing your own colour, every piece is made to be held, admired and worn.</p><p style="margin-bottom:28px">Shades flatter rather than mask. Cases are finished in rose-gold and set with a single blush gem. The result is makeup that feels like an heirloom and wears like your favourite Tuesday.</p><a class="btn" href="#new">Discover the collection</a></div></div></section>
<section id="new"><span id="shop"></span><div class="sh"><h2>The Enchanted Collection</h2><p>Four rose-embossed pieces in rose-gold cases. <div class="k">In stock (demonstration)</div><div class="pdq"><div class="q"><button data-pq="-1" aria-label="Less">−</button>${pdq}<button data-pq="1" aria-label="More">+</button></div><button class="btn" data-pa="1" style="flex:1">Add to bag</button><button class="wl ${wl.includes(p.id)?'on':''}" style="position:static" data-w="${p.id}" aria-label="Wishlist"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 20s-8-5-8-11a4.5 4.5 0 018-2.5A4.5 4.5 0 0120 9c0 6-8 11-8 11z"/></svg></button></div>
<details open><summary>Key benefits</summary><ul>${p.b.map(x=>`<li>${x}</li>`).join('')}</ul></details>
<details><summary>Key ingredients</summary><ul>${p.key.map(x=>`<li><b>${x}</b>: ${G[x]}</li>`).join('')}</ul></details>
<details><summary>Full ingredients (INCI)</summary><p>${p.inci}</p><p class="k">Pigment compositions may vary between shades.</p></details>
<details><summary>Formula &amp; texture</summary><p>${p.tx}</p></details>
<details><summary>Shade guide</summary><ul>${p.sh.map(x=>`<li><span style="display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:${x[1]};margin-right:8px"></span>${x[0]}: ${x[3]} (${x[2]})</li>`).join('')}</ul><p class="k">On-screen colors may differ from the physical product.</p></details>
<details><summary>How to use</summary><p>${p.use}</p></details>
<details><summary>Storage &amp; warnings</summary><p>Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For external use only. Discontinue use if irritation occurs.</p></details>
<p class="note">Sample formulation for a fictional brand concept. Not a verified manufactured formula, and no certifications or clinical testing are claimed.</p></div>`}
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),S=JSON.parse('{}');let cart=[],wl=[];
const sel={};const money=n=>'Rp'+n.toLocaleString('id-ID');let cat='All',pdid=1,pdq=1,srt='rec',prc='all',fnh='all';
function card(p,star){sel[p.id]=sel[p.id]||0;const s=p.sh[sel[p.id]];
return `<article class="card" data-id="${p.id}"><div class="phw"><div class="ph" data-pd="${p.id}" style="cursor:pointer"><img src="${p.img}" alt="${p.n}"></div><span class="tag">${p.tag}</span><button class="wl ${wl.includes(p.id)?'on':''}" aria-label="Add to wishlist" data-w="${p.id}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 20s-8-5-8-11a4.5 4.5 0 018-2.5A4.5 4.5 0 0120 9c0 6-8 11-8 11z"/></svg></button></div><div class="bd"><button class="lk" data-pd="${p.id}"><h3>${p.n}</h3></button><div class="k">${p.k}</div>${star?'<div class="stars">★★★★★</div>':''}
<div class="sw" role="group" aria-label="Shade">${p.sh.map((x,i)=>`<button class="${i==sel[p.id]?'on':''}" style="background:${x[1]}" aria-label="${x[0]}" data-s="${p.id}:${i}"></button>`).join('')}</div>
<div class="sn">${s[0]} · ${s[2]}</div><div class="pr">${money(p.p)}</div><button class="qv" data-pd="${p.id}">Quick view</button><button class="add" data-a="${p.id}">Add to bag</button></div></article>`}
function render(){$('#g1').innerHTML=flt().map(p=>card(p)).join('')||'<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">No products match these filters. Try clearing one.</div>';drawLook();$('#chips').innerHTML=['All','Eyes','Lips','Cheeks','Face'].map(c=>`<button class="${c==cat?'on':''}" data-c="${c}">${c}</button>`).join('');if($('#pd').classList.contains('on'))drawPD();$('#g2').innerHTML=[P[1],P[3],P[0],P[2]].map(p=>card(p,1)).join('');
$('#wc').textContent=wl.length;$('#cc').textContent=cart.reduce((a,c)=>a+c.q,0);drawCart();drawWish()}
function drawCart(){const t=cart.reduce((a,c)=>a+c.q*P.find(p=>p.id==c.id).p,0);
$('#ci').innerHTML=cart.length?cart.map((c,i)=>{const p=P.find(x=>x.id==c.id);return `<div class="li"><img src="${p.img}" alt=""><div><h4>${p.n}</h4><small>${c.sh}</small><div class="q"><button data-q="${i}:-1" aria-label="Less">−</button>${c.q}<button data-q="${i}:1" aria-label="More">+</button></div></div><b>${money(p.p*c.q)}</b></div>`}).join(''):'<div class="empty">Your bag is empty.<br>Add a shade to begin.</div>';
const left=Math.max(0,300000-t);$('#cf').innerHTML=cart.length?`<div class="ship">${left?`Add ${money(left)} for complimentary shipping`:'You’ve unlocked complimentary shipping'}</div><div class="pg"><i style="width:${Math.min(100,t/300000*100)}%"></i></div><div class="tot"><span>Subtotal</span><span>${money(t)}</span></div><button class="btn" id="co">Checkout</button>`:''}
function drawWish(){$('#wi').innerHTML=wl.length?wl.map(id=>{const p=P.find(x=>x.id==id);return `<div class="li"><img src="${p.img}" alt=""><div><h4>${p.n}</h4><small>${money(p.p)}</small></div><button class="btn o" style="padding:8px 14px" data-a="${p.id}">Add</button></div>`}).join(''):'<div class="empty">Tap the heart on any product to save it here.</div>'}
function toast(m){const t=$('#t');t.textContent=m;t.classList.add('on');clearTimeout(toast.h);toast.h=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('on'),2200)}
function open(id){close();$('#ov').classList.add('on');$(id).classList.add('on')}
function close(){document.querySelectorAll('.dr,.sr,.ov').forEach(e=>e.classList.remove('on'))}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!e.target.closest('#shopnav,#mega'))$('#mega').classList.remove('on');const y=e.target.closest('[data-pa],[data-pq]');if(y){if(y.dataset.pq){pdq=Math.max(1,pdq+ +y.dataset.pq);drawPD()}else{const p=P.find(x=>x.id==pdid),sh=p.sh[sel[p.id]||0][0],f=cart.find(c=>c.id==p.id&&c.sh==sh);f?f.q+=pdq:cart.push({id:p.id,sh,q:pdq});render();toast('Added to your bag')}return}
const z=e.target.closest('[data-pd]');if(z&&!e.target.closest('[data-w],[data-s],[data-a]')){pdid=+z.dataset.pd;pdq=1;open('#pd');drawPD();return}
const b=e.target.closest('button,a');if(!b)return;const d=b.dataset;
if(d.a){const p=P.find(x=>x.id==d.a),sh=p.sh[sel[p.id]||0][0];const f=cart.find(c=>c.id==p.id&&c.sh==sh);f?f.q++:cart.push({id:p.id,sh,q:1});render();toast('Added to your bag');if(b.closest('#wish'))return;}
else if(d.s){const[i,j]=d.s.split(':');sel[i]=+j;render()}
else if(d.w){const i=+d.w;wl=wl.includes(i)?wl.filter(x=>x!=i):[...wl,i];render()}
else if(d.q){const[i,n]=d.q.split(':');cart[i].q+=+n;if(cart[i].q<1)cart.splice(i,1);render()}
else if(d.x!==undefined)close();
else if(d.c){cat=d.c;$('#mega').classList.remove('on');render()}else if(b.id=='lg'){setLang(lang=='id'?'en':'id')}else if(d.lk){lkS.has(+d.lk)?lkS.delete(+d.lk):lkS.add(+d.lk);drawLook()}else if(d.ing){ing=+d.ing;drawIng()}else if(d.sc){$('#g2').scrollBy({left:+d.sc*300,behavior:'smooth'})}else if(d.nav){const v=d.nav;if(v=='shop')location.hash='#shop';else if(v=='search'){open('#sr');$('#sq').focus()}else if(v=='wish')open('#wish');else open('#cart')}else if(b.id=='shoplook'){if(!lkS.size){toast('Choose at least one piece');return}LOOK.forEach(([i,j],k)=>{if(!lkS.has(k))return;const p=P[i],sh=p.sh[j][0],f=cart.find(c=>c.id==p.id&&c.sh==sh);f?f.q++:cart.push({id:p.id,sh,q:1})});render();toast('The Enchanted Look is in your bag')}else if(b.id=='shopnav'){e.preventDefault();$('#mega').classList.toggle('on')}else if(b.id=='nl'){/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test($('#nem').value)?toast('Thank you. You are on the list'):toast('Enter a valid email address')}else if(b.id=='co'){toast('Checkout will connect to a Midtrans/Xendit sandbox. No payment is processed.')}
else if(b.id=='bb')open('#cart');else if(b.id=='bw')open('#wish');else if(b.id=='ba')open('#acct');
else if(b.id=='bs'){open('#sr');$('#sq').focus()}else if(b.id=='mb')$('#mn').classList.toggle('on');
else if(b.id=='si'){toast('Welcome to CARÉL');close()}
else if(b.matches('.mnav a'))$('#mn').classList.remove('on')});
$('#ov').onclick=close;document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>e.key=='Escape'&&close());
$('#sq').oninput=e=>{const q=e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim(),r=q?P.filter(p=>(p.n+p.k+p.sh.map(s=>s[0]).join()).toLowerCase().includes(q)):[];
$('#sg').innerHTML=r.map(p=>`<div class="card"><div class="ph" style="aspect-ratio:1"><img src="${p.img}" alt=""></div><div class="bd"><h3>${p.n}</h3><div class="pr">${money(p.p)}</div></div></div>`).join('');
$('#sm').textContent=q?(r.length?r.length+' found':'No matches. Try “blush”, “gloss” or “palette”.'):'Try “blush”, “gloss” or “palette”.'};
const A=['Complimentary shipping on orders over Rp300.000','New: the Once Upon a Dream collection has arrived','Enjoy two complimentary samples with every order'];let ai=0;
const bar=$('#bar span');bar.textContent=A[0];setInterval(()=>{bar.style.opacity=0;setTimeout(()=>{ai=(ai+1)%A.length;bar.textContent=A[ai];bar.style.opacity=1},500)},4500);
const LOOK=[[0,2],[3,0],[1,0],[2,1]],lkS=new Set([0,1,2,3]);
function flt(){let r=P.filter(p=>(cat=='All'||p.cat==cat)&&(prc=='all'||(prc=='a'?p.p<100000:prc=='b'?p.p>=100000&&p.p<=125000:p.p>125000))&&(fnh=='all'||p.sh.some(s=>s[2]==fnh)));
if(srt=='low')r.sort((a,b)=>a.p-b.p);else if(srt=='high')r.sort((a,b)=>b.p-a.p);else if(srt=='name')r.sort((a,b)=>a.n.localeCompare(b.n));else if(srt=='new')r.sort((a,b)=>(b.tag=='New')-(a.tag=='New'));else if(srt=='best')r.sort((a,b)=>(b.tag!='New')-(a.tag!='New'));return r}
function drawLook(){const tot=LOOK.reduce((a,[i],k)=>a+(lkS.has(k)?P[i].p:0),0);$('#look4').innerHTML=LOOK.map(([i,j],k)=>{const p=P[i];return `<button class="lk4 ${lkS.has(k)?'on':''}" data-lk="${k}" aria-pressed="${lkS.has(k)}"><div class="mini"><img src="${p.img}" alt="${p.n}"></div><h4>${p.n}</h4><small>${p.k}<br>${p.sh[j][0]}</small><div class="pr">${money(p.p)}</div></button>`}).join('')+`<div class="lkb"><div class="pr">${lkS.size} of 4 pieces · ${money(tot)}</div><button class="btn" id="shoplook">Shop the look</button></div>`}
const ING=[['Tocopherol','Tocopherol','Vitamin E','Antioxidant','An antioxidant ingredient used in cosmetic formulations to help protect oils and other formula components from oxidation.'],['Squalane','Squalane','Lightweight emollient','Emollient','Helps provide a smooth, soft skin feel and supports the comfortable texture of the lip formula.'],['Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil','Castor Seed Oil','Rich emollient','Emollient','An emollient that contributes to the smooth, conditioning feel of lip products.'],['Mica','Mica','Soft luminous mineral','Effect pigment','Creates reflective effects and helps produce dimensional shimmer in makeup.'],['Boron Nitride','Boron Nitride','Silky powder texture','Texture enhancer','Helps create a silky application feel and a refined powder finish.'],['Silica','Silica','Smooth texture','Texture modifier','Helps create a soft powder texture and modifies the sensory finish.'],['Dimethicone','Dimethicone','Smooth application','Silicone-based slip agent','Improves spreadability and contributes to a smooth, comfortable application.'],['Hydrogenated Polyisobutene','Hydrogenated Polyisobutene','Glossy emollient','Emollient','Helps create the smooth, glossy texture associated with lip gloss formulations.']];let ing=0;
function drawIng(){$('#ingg').innerHTML=ING.map((x,i)=>`<button class="ic2 ${i==ing?'on':''}" data-ing="${i}" aria-pressed="${i==ing}"><div class="gem">${x[1][0]}</div><h4>${x[1]}</h4><small>${x[2]}</small></button>`).join('');const x=ING[ing],ps=P.filter(p=>p.key.includes(x[0]));
$('#ingp').innerHTML=`<div><small>${x[3]}</small><h3>${x[1]}</h3><em>INCI: ${x[0]}</em></div><div><p><b>Why it matters.</b> ${x[4]}</p><p style="margin-top:16px"><small>Found in</small><br>${ps.map(p=>`<button class="lnk" data-pd="${p.id}">${p.n} · ${p.k}</button>`).join('')}</p></div>`}
document.addEventListener('change',e=>{const i=e.target.id;if(i=='srt')srt=e.target.value;else if(i=='prc')prc=e.target.value;else if(i=='fnh')fnh=e.target.value;else return;render()});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-pi]').forEach(i=>i.src=P[i.dataset.pi].img);
$('#shopnav').onmouseenter=()=>$('#mega').classList.add('on');document.querySelector('header').onmouseleave=()=>$('#mega').classList.remove('on');
const hide=()=>{const l=$('#ld');if(l){l.style.opacity=0;setTimeout(()=>l.remove(),700)}};addEventListener('load',()=>setTimeout(hide,600));setTimeout(hide,3000);

const PAT=[[/^Add (.+) for complimentary shipping$/,m=>`Tambah ${m[1]} untuk gratis ongkir`],[/^(\d) of 4 pieces · (.+)$/,m=>`${m[1]} dari 4 produk · ${m[2]}`],[/^(.+) · Net (.+)$/,m=>`${tr(m[1])||m[1]} · Isi bersih ${m[2]}`],[/^(\d+) found$/,m=>`${m[1]} ditemukan`],[/^(.+): (.+) \((Matte|Shimmer|Satin)\)$/,m=>`${m[1]}: ${tr(m[2])||m[2]} (${m[3]})`]];
function tr(s){let pre='';if(s.startsWith('· ')){pre='· ';s=s.slice(2)}else if(s.startsWith(': ')){pre=': ';s=s.slice(2)}
let r=DICT[s];if(r!==undefined)return pre+r;for(const[re,f]of PAT){const m=s.match(re);if(m)return pre+f(m)}
if(s.includes(' · ')){let any=0;const o=s.split(' · ').map(x=>{const y=DICT[x];if(y!==undefined){any=1;return y}return x});if(any)return pre+o.join(' · ')}return null}
let lang='en';const orig=new WeakMap();let touched=[];
function doNode(n){const v=n.nodeValue;if(!v||!v.trim())return;const m=v.match(/^(\s*)([\s\S]*?)(\s*)$/),r=tr(m[2]);if(r!==null&&r!==m[2]){orig.set(n,v);touched.push(n);n.nodeValue=m[1]+r+m[3]}}
function doAttrs(root){const els=root.querySelectorAll?[...root.querySelectorAll('[placeholder],[aria-label]'),...(root.matches&&root.matches('[placeholder],[aria-label]')?[root]:[])]:[];els.forEach(el=>{[['placeholder','oPh'],['aria-label','oAl']].forEach(([a,k])=>{const v=el.getAttribute(a);if(v&&DICT[v]!==undefined&&!el.dataset[k]){el.dataset[k]=v;el.setAttribute(a,DICT[v])}})})}
function walk(root){if(lang!='id')return;if(root.nodeType==3){doNode(root);return}if(root.nodeType!=1)return;const w=document.createTreeWalker(root,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,{acceptNode:n=>/^(SCRIPT|STYLE)$/.test(n.parentNode.nodeName)?2:1}),a=[];let n;while(n=w.nextNode())a.push(n);a.forEach(doNode);doAttrs(root)}
function setLang(l){lang=l;document.documentElement.lang=l;if(l=='en'){touched.forEach(n=>{if(n.isConnected&&orig.has(n))n.nodeValue=orig.get(n)});touched=[];document.querySelectorAll('[data-o-ph],[data-o-al]').forEach(el=>{if(el.dataset.oPh){el.setAttribute('placeholder',el.dataset.oPh);delete el.dataset.oPh}if(el.dataset.oAl){el.setAttribute('aria-label',el.dataset.oAl);delete el.dataset.oAl}})}else walk(document.body);
document.querySelectorAll('#lg span').forEach((s,i)=>s.classList.toggle('on',(i==1)==(l=='id')));try{localStorage.setItem('carel-lang',l)}catch(e){}}
new MutationObserver(ms=>{if(lang!='id')return;ms.forEach(m=>m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>walk(n)))}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});

drawIng();
render();
try{if(localStorage.getItem('carel-lang')=='id')setLang('id')}catch(e){}
</script></body></html>
